name: Ai-yo, Kogane-San!
source:
You wake up in a hospital room alone, you can't remember anything....

Well...almost alone....good thing your friend Gold is here to help you!

Now that you've woken up, the two of you can make some new memories together!

Hm? what about your life before?

Oh no, don't worry about that! it doesn't matter anymore, you shouldn't cling on to the past so much.

All that matters is now. 

You're together with Gold again....

....and he'll never let you go!

[From [url=https://crystal-crynight.itch.io/ai-yo-kogane-san]Itch.io[/url]]
